Nina (AE): starting MistralBridge POC — customer migrating from VeloAI and wants near-zero client changes. Key asks: stop-token parity, predictable token billing, security questionnaire answers.
Omar (SE): plan: lightweight compat shim + canonical prompt templates. Will emulate VeloAI stop-substring behavior in post-processing.
Tess (Security): provide SOC2 pointer, subprocessors list, KMS options (BYOK only on Private), 30/90 day audit log retention choices.
Ben (Sales Ops): POC credits: 100k free standard, can upsell 250k for prepay. Dev rates: gen $0.0032/token, embed $0.00038.
Nina (AE): they reported ~22% token delta in sample runs — request tokenization parity pass across 8 prompts.
Omar (SE): will run parity, return token delta + normalized outputs. I'll drop a minimal curl shim example and a docker repo link after this.
InfraBot: scheduled dev pool allocation: pool-mistralbridge at 2024-12-04T08:00:00Z (ref: sha: b7c8d9).
Tess (Security): need subprocessor list and dataflow diagram; will draft SQ responses once received.
Nina (AE): action items: Omar -> parity script & shim example; Ben -> POC credit proforma; Tess -> SQ draft. Scheduling kickoff 09:00 CET tomorrow.
__notes: Compact presales Slack thread for MistralBridge POC migration from VeloAI competitor. Single-thread content string.
